citations.claim: first violation: body 1 centre beyond right arena bound
body 1 racing toward right wall just before escape
initial position inside arena before momentum transfer

explanation: Heavy (20kg, 40m/s) elastic impact on light (1kg) body produces ~76.19 m/s via 1D elastic formula (2*m1/(m1+m2)*v1), matching observed speeds. Light large-radius body then hits the right arena boundary at extreme speed; boundary impulse/positional correction fails to contain it, leaving 0.43 overshoot beyond 0.15 tolerance at step 9.
vision_note: The large red body moves rightward toward the arena edge across steps 6-8 and at step 9 is visibly half outside the right boundary wall. The small blue body remains fully inside while the red body protrudes beyond the wall.
